current_coloc_gwas.evidence: The exact NeurIPS checkpoint was not the paper's main OneK1K/GTEx eQTL benchmark model, but reproduction code applies its family REF/ALT exon-sum method to fine-mapped variants. Treat the readout as downstream-demo evidence; MASLD GWAS and COLOC labels were not training targets.

gse244832.evidence: The October 2024 checkpoint predates GSE244832 public release and its liver stellate profiles are absent from the explicit NeurIPS corpus.

gse281160.evidence: The perturbation source became public after the checkpoint and was not a training target.

gse281364.evidence: The MPRA source became public after the checkpoint and was not in the training corpus.

gse289173.evidence: The immutable NeurIPS weight predates GSE289173 public release by four months. Its MASLD cell labels, donor eQTLs and interaction-eQTL outcomes could not have entered the checkpoint. Generic reference sequence and inherited functional-genomics priors remain expected.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public nearly a year after the checkpoint. Its liver multiome, QTL and histopathology outcomes were unexposed.

resource_atlas_current.evidence: No Resource MASLD labels or frozen programs were targets. The learned single-cell decoder is hematopoietic, while generic liver priors can only be inherited from Borzoi.

interpretation: NeurIPS scooby has the cleanest sealed chronology of the three checkpoints, but chronology does not solve topology. Its 14-D context was trained from observed RNA and ATAC, the encoder is absent and cross-tissue/donor induction was not established.

rules.cell_embedding: The exact Poisson-MultiVI reference model, retained feature universe, sample-batch handling and query posterior are part of the checkpoint input. A new 14-D latent is not interchangeable.
rules.genome_overlap: Any adaptation crosses donor folds with chromosome/LD blocks and a 524288-bp buffer.
rules.rna_conditioned_atac: No inference request may expose ATAC counts, ATAC-derived neighbors, peak features or a latent computed from them. Only a prespecified RNA-only query projection can reactivate the candidate.
rules.sealed_rule: GSE289173 has RNA only. Do not fit a bridge, encoder, calibration or threshold using its outcomes after unblinding.
